sections.name: persona tool maths
sections.title: Checks the sports maths for persona tools
sections.what: Checks two Formula 1 calculations: how many seconds a tyre loses per lap, ignoring pit-out laps and outliers, and when a pit-stop window opens. It also checks basketball win chance from the score lead and time left, and how much a close late moment matters (clutch leverage).
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The tests confirm the formulas return the expected answers on made-up numbers.
sections.watch_out: The lap times are invented, so these tests prove the maths works but not that the real tyre figures are right.
